name: An INPS pension in Germany (DE, taxedIn source)
workings: The INPS pension is a foreign statutory pension: 86% taxable for a 2030 start, like the DRV pension
Health: DRV 1,785.84 + INPS 8.75% × 12,000 = 1,050.00 (half the rate; nobody pays the other half); care 4.2% × 32,409.60 = 1,361.2032 (the full care rate on a foreign pension too)

A German national (not Italian): the treaty gives the INPS pension to Germany, although the plan says Italy taxes it. Germany taxes it anyway, with a warning, so it isn't left untaxed (Italy's convention too); no tax charged in Italy is given here (sourceTax), so nothing is credited: see inps-pension-german-national-credit
